story: Jatayu, the old vulture king, was a friend of Rama's father Dasharatha. When he saw Ravana carrying Sita away, he attacked Ravana's flying chariot, and Ravana cut off his wings. Dying, he told Rama which way Sita had been taken, and Rama performed his funeral rites himself.
belief: He is honoured as a symbol of sacrifice and courage. Jatayu Earth's Center in Kerala has one of the largest bird sculptures in the world in his memory.
turns: Old and outmatched, he attacked Ravana anyway, knowing he would probably die.
facts: His brother Sampati burned his wings shielding Jatayu from the sun when they flew too high.
Lepakshi in Andhra Pradesh is said to come from Rama's words 'Le, pakshi' ('Rise, bird').
Rama performed his last rites as a son would for a father.
